tools.name: read
tools.description: Reads continuous text from a volume: a whole chapter, a page range, or the passages around a given passage number. Returns up to about 12,000 characters with page numbers; longer selections end with the passage number to continue from. The reply text begins with the fixed phrase "Steiner hat gesagt:

tools.name: list_works
tools.description: Catalogue of all volumes in the Gesamtausgabe with title, section and whether the full text is available. Filter by title words, section and the year lectures were held. The reply text begins with the fixed phrase "Steiner hat gesagt:".

tools.name: get_work
tools.description: Details for one volume plus its table of contents (chapters/lectures with number, heading, date, place and pages). The reply text begins with the fixed phrase "Steiner hat gesagt:".

tools.name: count_matches
tools.description: Counts how many passages (and chapters/lectures) match a German full-text query, grouped by year, by volume or by place. findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "read" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.
